chapters.title: Introduction: Badi Badi Baatein, Wada Pao Khaate
Chapter 1: That Which is Seen and That Which is Not Seen -- The great Frédéric Bastiat
Chapter 2: The Use of Knowledge in Society -- The great Friedrich Hayek

episode.tagline: Frédéric Bastiat taught us to seen the Unseen effects of our actions. Friedrich Hayek showed us how economies and societies really function.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay discuss the powerul ideas of two great Freddies. We learn how our government, like most goverments, redistributes FROM THE POOR TO THE RICH. We understand how economies work -- not through central planning, but the decentralised coordination of the price system. Amit and Ajay also recommend their favourite books for understanding how markets work.
